static_traits.name: 林雅芝
static_traits.occupation: 好莱坞的Male模特志愿者（立志成为Male模）
static_traits.social_status: 有人际支持（有朋友可交谈），但尚not yet向朋友谈及具体担忧；Interpersonal relationships受到对被评价为“生病的孩子”的恐惧影响
static_traits.medical_history: 18岁时曾患泌尿系统癌症并完成治疗；目前without显著身体疾病；not yet接受过心理治疗
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，能自我Reflection与描述具体情境；配合度较好但带有怀疑态度；情绪体验以Anxiety为主；在社交话题上谨慎、易担忧

basic_info.main_problem: 我担心人们会一直把我看作曾患癌症的“生病的孩子”，这让我长期Anxiety和担心，尤其在社交情境中。
basic_info.core_demands: 我决定寻求咨询，因为这些被贴上“生病的孩子”标签的感受开始影响我成为Male模的自信与志向。
growth_experiences: 18岁时经历并战胜泌尿系统癌症。治疗结束后并not yet感到如释重负，因健康not确定性导致的压力很高，Anxiety与担忧自那时持续至今。在社交场合（认识新朋友、参加活动）尤为突出，逐渐发展为对他人评价的恐惧和自我意识过强，影响Interpersonal relationships、职业信心以及饮食和睡眠。

core_beliefs: 我会一直被视为生病的孩子
我的价值会被我的病史覆盖

special_situations.event: When meeting new friends at social occasions or attending activities
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人知道我曾经患癌，就会看轻我，只把我当作“生病的孩子”而not是完整的我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-soothing and distraction (keeping busy through work), reducing self-exposure and avoiding in-depth communication
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们一定在心里看not起我、只把我当成那个生过病的孩子

special_situations.event: At industry social or networking events (such as last week's networking event)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果被当作“生病的孩子”，do not人就not会用才貌或能力来评判我，我将without法在模特行业获得机会
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Leaves early, lowers participation to avoid being scrutinized
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我会被以病史而not是实力评判，结果只会更糟

special_situations.event: 在社交活动中have not人直接提及病史时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我感到强烈的紧张和not适，就说明他们正在评判或议论我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 继续Self-monitoring与内心反刍，难以停留在现场
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I feel terrible; this must mean they are talking about me behind my back

special_situations.event: When thinking about talking to friends about one's specific worries
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我表达担忧，就会给do not人增加负担并被负面看待
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids talking about it, keeps worries pressed in his heart, bears them alone
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not该麻烦do not人，他们会觉得我有问题

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be seen as a 'complete and capable person', to be accepted and recognized interpersonally and professionally (evaluated by talent, appearance and effort)
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被贴上“生病的孩子”的标签而被贬低、Being rejected、失去机会
defense_goal: Reduces the chance of being judged by avoiding in-depth socializing
Keeps worries pressed in the heart to maintain outward stability and safety
通过保持忙碌来分散Anxiety与自我关注

object_relations.self_representation: A fragile self easily labeled (may be defined by others through medical history at any time)
object_relations.object_representation: 他人是潜在的评判者与拒绝者（会看轻并negate我）

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing or entering social settings, especially networking and industry events
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Others will see me with the label 'sick child' as in the past and are secretly judging me (transference: bringing the expectation of being judged into the current relationship)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 保持同理与稳定语气，邀请其检视证据与可能性；use开放式Questioning，引导其区分感受与事实，温和挑战“心读”假设。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When thinking about expressing specific worries to friends or others
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 如果说出来会给do not人增加负担并被负面看待
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以支持性语气逐步探询其not yet表达的担忧，提供安全框架；鼓励小步尝试分享，肯定其节奏与界限。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当被问及not与朋友讨论的原因或为提前离场寻找理由时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 我not该麻烦do not人、他们可能not想听（为回避与退场进行自我辩护）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 温和标注Rationalization倾向，邀请其区分“关心他人”与“自我回避”；用具体化与再归因技术探索更多可能的理解。

manifestations: Hard to open up to others and build intimate relationships
Stays guarded at social activities and leaves early
有朋友却not yet谈及具体担忧，选择独自承受
outcomes: Sleep and eating disrupted，整体Decreased quality of life

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Highly self-conscious and tense in social settings
假设他人正在评判自己
Carefully avoids in-depth exchange to reduce the risk of being scrutinized

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves.
manifestations: not向朋友表达具体担忧而选择独自承受
以“我not该麻烦do not人”为由Suppressing expression需求

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: 在have not证据的情况下假定他人看轻或议论自己
将内在的羞耻和Anxiety体验归因于他人的负面看法

positive_force: Has social support resources (friends to talk with)
愿意尝试识do not与挑战负性思维、接受重构练习
Can notice and name cognitive patterns (mind reading, overgeneralization, mental filtering)
Has overcome a major illness, showing resilience and persistence
negative_force: Caring excessively about others' evaluations and labeling的担忧
心读与预测not yet来、情绪化推理等认知偏差ReinforcementAnxiety
Avoidance and self-hiding in social settings (leaving early, reducing communication)
Sleep and eating rhythms disturbed，进一步降低情绪与功能状态

target_behavior.behavior: 在社交活动中出现高度Anxiety并提前离场
antecedent: Meeting new friends or attending social/industry events
Thinking others may know or talk about one's past illness history
target_behavior.core_reason: 担心被贴上“生病的孩子”的标签并被贬低、Being rejected，由此产生灾难化与心读倾向
target_behavior.function: 逃避被评判与负性情绪体验，迅速降低当下Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 错失人脉与机会，Career development受阻，Interpersonal relationships维持在浅层

target_behavior.behavior: not向朋友表达具体担忧、选择独自承受
antecedent: 想到要谈及自己的Anxiety或病史相关担忧
Facing opportunities for intimate interaction or seeking support
target_behavior.core_reason: 担心给他人增加负担并被负面看待，倾向Rationalization与Repression情绪需求
target_behavior.function: Avoids possible embarrassment or being judged, maintaining surface stability and a sense of control
target_behavior.consequence: 社会支持not yet被充分利用，孤立感与Anxiety维持甚至加重
